name: Return
notes: EU: local currency; used by the return-based filters

name: Return_EUR
notes: EU only; same row removals and delisting return as Return

name: BidAsk_Spread
formula: EDGE estimator (Ardia et al.) over 21 trading days; clipped to [0; 0.25]

name: IsFilled
formula: True if one of the forward-filled price columns was missing on that day
inputs: Open; High; Low; Close; ReturnIndex; AdjFactor; UnadjClose

name: DelistingReturnApplied
formula: True on the last observation of a delisted stock where the delisting return was compounded in

name: size_group
formula: quintile of month-end market cap (1 = smallest)
inputs: MarketCAP (US: NYSE breakpoints); MarketCAP_EUR (EU: all European stocks)

name: size_group_country
formula: quintile of month-end MarketCAP_EUR within the country

name: ret
formula: ReturnIndex at month end t / at month end t-1 - 1 (consecutive months only)
notes: contains the delisting return; EU: local currency

name: ret_eur
formula: ReturnIndex_EUR at month end t / at month end t-1 - 1 (consecutive months only)

name: retx
formula: Close at month end t / at month end t-1 - 1 (consecutive months only)

name: bm
formula: common equity / market value of equity
inputs: WC03501 (thousands); MarketCAP x 1000 (millions); EU euro countries: MarketCAP_EUR x 1000
notes: point in time (availability lag); multi-class firms: too high (equity of the firm / value of one class) - per-share version with WC05301 planned

name: ep
formula: net income / market value of equity
inputs: WC01751; same market value as bm
notes: same caveats as bm; replaces Datastream PE (ep = 1/PE but point in time and defined for losses)

name: dy_12m
formula: sum of the last 12 monthly dividend returns (ret - retx; clipped at 0)
notes: requires 12 consecutive monthly returns; replaces Datastream DY

name: <var>_prev
formula: value of the latest earlier report at least 9 months older (normally the previous fiscal year)
notes: readable name + _prev (e.g. total_assets_prev); available together with the current report

name: fund_report_month
formula: month in which the current Worldscope snapshot appeared (any item changed)

name: fund_available_month
formula: first month in which the snapshot is used

name: fund_age_months
formula: months between the current month and fund_report_month
notes: snapshots older than max_age_months (18 rolling / 24 ff) are not used

name: fund_prev_report_month
formula: report month of the snapshot used for <var>_prev
